cpu_affinity.reason: Hybrid CPU and observed unrelated background load. Pin single-thread API samples to the same performance core; retain normal priority. Multi-thread samples use all logical processors. User processes are not modified.

timing.contract: Rotated/reversed independent-process variant order; first calls excluded from medians, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Optional prewarm runs are archived separately and were declared before the cohort. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.

excluded_attempt.reason: Two-variant rotation plus flattened-job reversal cancelled variant-order reversal. Driver interrupted; no final measured report. Both prewarms retained. Owned child no longer running before retry.

limitations: Four independent process rounds; two calls after each first call; balanced two-variant order and identical affinity/profile/package selection.
All agents confirmed idle; root ran no builds, tests, scans or source edits during the complete replacement timing cohort.
1-thread mean gain is 1.55%, with every paired process mean improving; 16-thread mean +0.69% and median -0.55% are not a clear multithread improvement.
Eight samples make nearest-rank p95 the maximum, not a precise population tail.
Only unique-input 1/16-thread workloads measured here. Do not multiply original/W5 and W5/W6 ratios from separate cohorts.
Profile wall times overlap validation work and are diagnostic only; this run did not instrument allocation events.
Latest actual Wasm validation is W5. W6 workspace-wide rerun has not been performed; focused restructure and 15 native release gates passed.
